notes: The manifest is durable runtime configuration. The stable server only interprets route/source/style/script metadata; all page-owned code remains on runtime. Ice Dragon is opt-in and persisted locally. Generated Ice Dragon artwork hydrates from browser-safe base64 text assets. The juvenile companion is used for the sidebar brand, assistant avatars, and new-chat welcome orb. The adult guardian is rendered by ice-dragon-art-loader-v6.js as a literal IMG node inside the Chat message chamber. The adult base64 is normalized, decoded with atob into binary bytes, wrapped in an image/jpeg Blob, and assigned through an object URL so Android Chrome does not need to decode the adult image from a data URL. The legacy message background is forced transparent while Ice Dragon is active. Chat boot stays behind the hydration guard until account-scoped state and, when relevant, Ice Dragon art are ready or the bounded fail-open timer expires. Pending stream request metadata is persisted locally so Chat can reattach to replayable server-side LALM generations after page backgrounding, reload, or return. Response polish keeps the assistant name out of ordinary output and preserves a natural intro/code/details/closing presentation for coding responses.
